title: Traversable Wormhole Transit
description: A full-screen WebGL wormhole renderer with adaptive RK4 null-geodesic integration in the reduced orbital plane, an observer frame parallel-transported through the throat, two procedural celestial spheres with dust extinction and flux-conserving star fields, progressive Halton accumulation, and a 13-tap bloom pyramid. Drag to look, W/A/S/D to fly, shift to sprint, wheel to zoom.
techniques: adaptive RK4 integration of the reduced three-variable null-geodesic system
exact orbital-plane reduction with conserved angular momentum
observer sphere frame parallel-transported through the throat
footprint-filtered galactic sky with dust extinction, HII emission, and three resolved star layers
flux-conserving Gaussian star point-spread with analytic mean-radiance fallback
progressive Halton accumulation with pixel-centred first sample
13-tap bloom pyramid, ACES composite, vignette, and grain
